acceptanceCriteria: retry --help describes --grant as a grant ID, with any help golden updated.
body: Observed on branch claude/v1-0475-multi-repo (head e62e5bdb, base origin/main d524530f), Corvint 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64, by the issue 354 lane. The corvint-tasks retry usage text documents --grant FILE, but the flag takes a grant ID. Expected: usage text names the value as a grant ID.
title: retry usage text says --grant FILE but the value is a grant ID
